digest.component_or_area: LLM agent toolset management and step limiting
propositions: tool_step_limit currently hides tools via filtering, causing Bedrock/Anthropic 400 ValidationException when toolUse history exists but toolConfig is omitted
bounded recovery fallback dies with the same provider protocol error when evidence runs reach the step limit
existing test suite misses the constraint because FunctionModel accepts tools-less requests over tool_use history, unlike real providers
steering wrapper mechanism must keep tool definitions advertised throughout the run while returning synthetic steering results past the limit to satisfy provider protocol
steered runs must still land final output through normal paths and remain terminally bounded by existing UsageLimits budget constraints
